sloka: नह्येष हन्तुं शक्यो ऽद्य वरदानात्सुनिर्भयः ।तद्ग्रहीष्यामहे रक्षो यत्ता भवत संयुगे ।। ७.२९.१५ ॥
transliteration: nahyeṣa hantuṁ śakyo 'dya varadānātsunirbhayaḥ ।tadgrahīṣyāmahe rakṣo yattā bhavata saṁyuge ।। 7.29.15 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, it is not possible to kill him today because he is very fearless due to the boon, therefore, let us capture this demon, and be prepared in battle.
